title: The behavior of triplet thymine in a model B-DNA strand. Energetics and spin density localization revealed by ab initio molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Laleh Allahkaram; Antonio MONARI; Elise Dumont
one_liner_zh: 该文用QM/MM分子动力学模拟研究B-DNA中胸腺嘧啶三线态能量与自旋密度，虽涉及DNA但聚焦光化学损伤而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或蛋白结合建模，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Among the natural occurring nucleobases, thymine presents the lowest triplet state, hence it represents a hotspot for energy transfer and photosensitization. In turn, the population of the triplet state may lead to thymine dimerization and hence to the production of toxic DNA lesions and has been the subject of intensive theoretical and experimental investigations. Relying on QM/MM molecular dynamics simulations, we have sought to situate the energy of the lowest triplet state of thymine embedded in a B-DNA environment. The energy gap varies between 305 and 329 kJ.mol−1 when a single thymine is treated at the quantum chemistry level, depending on its position in the model double-stranded 16-bp oligonucleotide. The energy of triplet state decreases up to 300 kJ.mol−1, due to polarization effects, when we consider coupled stacked nucleobases up to the inclusion of four nucleobases. Our value lies in good agreement with the energy inferred experimentally by Miranda and coworkers (270 kJ.mol−1), and our theoretical exploration opens the door to investigations toward other more complex and biological relevant environments, such as thymines embedded in nucleosome core particles. Our investigations also provide a reference for further studies using semiempirical approaches such as density functional based tight binding, allowing to further rationalize sequence effects.
abstract_zh: 在天然存在的核碱基中，胸腺嘧啶具有最低的三重态，因此它代表了能量转移和光敏化的热点。反过来，三重态的布居可能导致胸腺嘧啶二聚化，进而产生有毒的DNA损伤，这已成为理论和实验研究密集关注的主题。通过QM/MM分子动力学模拟，我们试图确定嵌入B-DNA环境中的胸腺嘧啶最低三重态的能量。当单个胸腺嘧啶在量子化学水平上处理时，能隙在305至329 kJ·mol⁻¹之间变化，具体取决于其在模型双链16-bp寡核苷酸中的位置。当考虑耦合堆叠核碱基直至包含四个核碱基时，由于极化效应，三重态的能量降低至300 kJ·mol⁻¹。我们的数值与Miranda及其同事实验推断的能量（270 kJ·mol⁻¹）良好吻合，我们的理论探索为研究其他更复杂且生物学相关的环境（如嵌入核小体核心颗粒中的胸腺嘧啶）打开了大门。我们的研究也为使用半经验方法（如基于密度泛函的紧束缚方法）的进一步研究提供了参考，从而有助于进一步合理化序列效应。
